Class Worksheet

java.lang.Object

    • freezePanes

      public void freezePanes(int row, int column, int freezedRows, int freezedCols)
      Freezes panes at the specified cell in the worksheet.
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index of the first unfrozen row
      column - zero-based column index of the first unfrozen column
      freezedRows - number of rows to freeze from the top
      freezedCols - number of columns to freeze from the left

    • freezePanes

      public void freezePanes(String cellName, int freezedRows, int freezedCols)
      Freezes panes at the specified cell in the worksheet.
      Parameters:
      cellName - name of the top-left cell of the unfrozen area (e.g. "B2")
      freezedRows - number of rows to freeze from the top
      freezedCols - number of columns to freeze from the left
